title: Owned native signaling credential refresh
implementation: Only a correlated, fully validated auth.session publishes a successor deadline to the existing single owned reader. Updating that deadline does not cancel an unfinished framed read.
The original pinned server-key expiry remains an immutable upper bound. Refused or unsolicited session frames cannot extend the reader. An expired/retired reader cannot be revived.

Public, private and prepared-handoff audio facades expose explicit credential refresh and cancellation. These update authentication; existing native media is still bound independently to its admitted source authority.

verified.scope: actual Connect owned signaling after original credential expiry
verified.meaning: A second signed refresh succeeds on the same owned peer/reader after the original seven-second credential has expired. This is signaling continuity, not media credential rebinding.

production_failure.observation: A valid explicitly enrolled successor refresh succeeds, then DTMF on the existing admitted media Connection is refused with forbidden. The new test remains failing and is not ignored.
production_failure.source_finding: Store native_streams::projection requires the exact credential recorded in native_admission_sources. Connect has no installed existing-media credential rebind. Core has rebind_media_credential_with_held; preserve the current exact-source check while implementing that composition.

earlier_attempts.result: Compile failure in a new test accessing a private task field. Removed that unnecessary field access; production code unchanged.
Unsolicited-session test incorrectly used a fixture requiring auth.refresh while sending keepalive. Corrected to the owned unsolicited-frame fixture; production code unchanged.
New test enrollment helper initially referenced the outer algorithm variable. Corrected to the explicit config signing algorithm.

not_qualified: Existing media credential rebinding and its queued/private signal, current permission, uncertainty and teardown cases. The production regression above is an explicit remaining failure.

current_regression.scope: Original8 private provider cases plus3 native/owned DTMF regressions. Retention return passes. Automatic cancel-export and ordinary fresh private provider cases fail with authority-busy during initialization. No whole-cohort pass claimed.

current_source_production_cohort.note: Media rebind remains failing and unignored on the current fair-metadata implementation. Signaling refresh beyond predecessor expiry passes with both algorithms.

native_credential_refresh_continuation.meaning: The previously failing existing-media refresh path now passes explicit Store epoch/Core revision checks, successor DTMF send/receive and independently decoded RTP after original expiry for both signing algorithms. Earlier results remain historical; full G6-046 and broader profiles remain open.
